label: Sync Gateway (the product/binary)
type: the Sync Gateway server software itself - the thing an operator installs, configures via command-line options, and deploys as one or more sgw:sync-gateway-instance processes. Distinct from any one running instance.
note: Filed under tool: rather than service: because it is a standalone, separately-shipped server binary (like tool:cbbackupmgr), not a service running inside a Couchbase Server cluster the way service:data-service or service:query-service are. Not to be confused with sgw:sync-gateway-instance, a deployed running process of this software.
